mapper.sql: id , goods_id, address_id, time, type, status, get_time,user_id,order_string,payment_price,num
mapper.select: select count(*) from orders where goods_id = #{goodsId} and `status` in (0, 1)

select orders.id as orderId, orders.time, orders.type, orders.status, orders.get_time, orders.payment_price, orders.order_string, orders.num, goods.id as goodsId, goods.name as goodsName, goods.images, address.*, `user`.id as userId from orders, goods, address, `user` where orders.goods_id = goods.id and orders.address_id = address.id and orders.address_id = address.id and `user`.id = address.user_id and orders.id = #{id}
select sum(t1.payment_price) moneys, count(t1.id) orders from `orders` t1 left join goods t2 on t1.goods_id =t2.id where t1.get_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and t1.get_time is not null

SELECT goods.id, goods.NAME, address.NAME AS customerName, address.address AS customerAddress, address.phone AS customerPhone, orders.time, orders.payment_price AS orderPrice, CASE orders.`status` WHEN 0 THEN '待发货' WHEN 1 THEN '待消费' WHEN 2 THEN '待评价' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '取消' ELSE '已发货' END AS orderStatus FROM goods AS goods RIGHT JOIN orders AS orders ON orders.goods_id = goods.id LEFT JOIN address AS address ON orders.address_id = address.id WHERE 1=1
and goods.class_id=#{classId}
and goods.name like CONCAT('%',#{likeName},'%')
and address.phone like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')
and address.name like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
